verdict.rationale: Together AI's core inference/training platform is closed-source SaaS with no evidence of an open license for the service itself; only its client SDKs (e.g., together-typescript) are published on GitHub as open-source libraries. This gives an AI-native user some readable open-license code (the client library) but not the actual product/service source. Missing for 10: any open-license repository for the core inference engine, model-serving stack, or platform backend, and no LICENSE evidence for the SDK repos themselves.
